column8: ["The teal housing has weight, but its cloudy surface and soft edging make glazed ceramic read more like weathered metal; give the glaze clearer depth and cleaner transitions.","The brass around the seat mouths and in the four repeated motifs reads as muddy brown edging, with little distinction between rubbed brass and matte rubber.","Pale upper-left bevels and dark lower-right rims impose a directional light; use balanced shading around the contours so the housing keeps its volume when rotated."]
